groundRules.rule: Cheats off on your platinum save
groundRules.why: Cheat codes have historically locked trophies in Rockstar games and GTA VI is expected to follow the same pattern (reported by OfZenAndComputing's launch coverage). If you want to play with cheats, do it on a separate save.

groundRules.rule: Keep up to 15 manual saves, rotated
groundRules.why: There is no mission replay (Output Lag). A save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission is the only insurance a single playthrough gets — it is also your fallback for the one potentially missable trophy.

groundRules.rule: Do the Chapter 1 meditation before you finish Chapter 1
groundRules.why: The meditation spot at the house in Chapter 1 becomes permanently unavailable after that chapter, per PowerPyx and GTABase. It takes a minute now, or a new playthrough later.

Chapter 2 makes both protagonists playable, which the partner trophies require, and the campaign opens the whole map. Free-roam grinding before the story is done means redoing travel the story would have covered.

groundRules.rule: Tick trophies off as you earn them
groundRules.why: 28 of the 55 trophies are hidden on PlayStation. This tracker — with the spoiler shield off once you have finished the story — is how you know exactly what is left.

intro: Seven stages, in the order that wastes the least time: ground rules first, story before free-roam cleanup (the story unlocks the map, the second protagonist and most systems), strands while they are fresh, then the 100% checklist, the long grinds, the money stage, and the one-offs that end with the platinum itself. Every time figure below is an estimate, labelled as such — the game launched on 2026-11-19 and no completion time is a promise.

missables.detail: Meditate at every spot across Leonida (18 spots). The risk is a single spot: the meditation at the house in Chapter 1 becomes permanently unavailable after Chapter 1 ends, per PowerPyx and GTABase, and there is no mission replay to go back with. Caveat, stated plainly: at launch its strict necessity was still being confirmed — it may yet prove reachable another way. Doing it in Chapter 1 costs a minute and removes the question entirely. Everything else in the list is documented as free-roam-safe: story and stranger trophies are reported unmissable, and every other trophy can be earned in free roam after the credits.
missables.name: Positive Mental Attitude
missables.sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap; GTABase — GTA VI Trophies & Achievements; Output Lag — GTA 6 Trophy List.
missables.status: Potentially missable — the only one flagged at launch

stages.name: Setup & Ground Rules
stages.summary: Before the first mission: read the ground rules above, start your rotating manual saves, and decide that this save is the platinum save — cheats never touch it. Everything in this stage is habit, not gameplay, and it is what makes the other six stages safe.
tips: Create your first manual save before Gone Fishing.
Bookmark this tracker and tick off trophies as they pop.

stages.name: Story First
stages.summary: Play the campaign straight through: five chapters, the named mission trophies, and the hidden gold for the final mission. This stage alone banks 16 of the 55 trophies, including every chapter trophy. Two things to do on the way, not after: the Chapter 1 meditation (the one missable risk in the game) and a manual save before the final mission. The vague story trophies — Personal Best, Actions Speak Louder, Bad Luck, I Guess — are reported to arrive during the campaign; there is nothing extra to hunt for them.
tips: Meditate at the house during Chapter 1, before the chapter ends.
Save at every chapter start; save again before the final mission.
Let Actions Speak Louder's counter fill by making choices as they come — do not chase the permanent Irredeemable profile.

stages.name: Stranger Strands
stages.summary: With the map open, work the stranger strands: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret each end in their own hidden trophy, and any 8 completed strands earn the Strangers & Freaks silver. Strands unlock in stages, so rotate between them as their markers refresh.
tips: Finish the six named strands first — they are six of the eight you need.
If a strand stalls, it is waiting on story or time; rotate to another.

stages.name: The 100% Checklist
stages.summary: The broad sweep that feeds A Long Road: one of each activity (Master of None), drone races at all 14 Top Fun locations, 20 different race wins, Cal's fishing challenge, an arcade game, 3 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 100 discovered vehicles, all 52 areas explored, and the robbery set — 3 shops back-to-back, a clean jewelry store, 5 bank vaults, an armoured truck, and one illegal operation per gang. The hidden one-offs live here too: the VCIA departure, the Rhino encounter, bowling at Kolt & Associates', and the unconfirmed Ocean Beach cocktail and showroom exit, which are labelled as community beliefs in their guides.
tips: Use this app's kind filters as your sweep lists — activities, then collectibles, then robberies.
Combine trips: explore a new area, WAiNK and meditate there, and discover its vehicles on the same visit.

stages.name: The Long Grinds
stages.summary: What remains is counted in hundreds: 250 stunts, gold in all 42 shooting range challenges, and 50 challenges — plus the two feats that need a set-up rather than a total: 5 takedowns in one Combat Focus, and losing a 4-star wanted level with your partner. Most of these totals should already be part-full from stages 2–4; this stage is deliberate, focused sessions to close them.
tips: The Shootist is the skill gate: learn each range challenge's pattern before chasing gold.
Stunts go fastest with a route — string spots together instead of crossing the map for one at a time.

stages.estimate: Estimate: 10–15 hours, much of it already banked
stages.name: Money & Property
stages.summary: Turn the run's earnings into the last purchases: launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts, spend $100,000 across shops, buy all 8 garage properties, and register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Robbery takes from stage 4 fund most of this; if you are short, more vaults and armoured trucks are the honest top-up.
tips: Launder marked bills whenever you are holding them — the total is cumulative.
Buy the garages before the final vehicle sweep; they make registering and storing finds easier.

stages.name: One-Offs & The Platinum
stages.summary: Sweep whatever is left: any one-off feats not yet landed, the last checklist percentage points for A Long Road, and any hidden trophy the shield has been keeping from you (turn it off now — the story is done). When the 54th trophy lands, Vice Got a Price! follows on its own. You are a Leonida Legend.
tips: Compare this tracker against the in-game list grade by grade: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze.
If one trophy is missing, check the hidden ones first — they are the easy ones to lose.

title: Roadmap to the Platinum — Vice Got a Price!
totalEstimate: Estimate: ~200 hours for the platinum in total (PowerPyx rates the platinum 4/10 difficulty at about 200 hours; U7Buy gives the same ~200 hour estimate). Long, not hard: there are no difficulty trophies and no online trophies.

unconfirmed.detail: In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Bad Luck, I Guess, The Truth Is Out There and Ten Pin are marked 'not yet known' by PowerPyx. Their guides in this app say so openly, work from the official descriptions, and label the circulating methods as community beliefs. Personal Best is likewise only reported — as a story moment — not confirmed. Nothing in this app invents steps for them.
unconfirmed.name: Five trophies with no confirmed trigger at launch
unconfirmed.sources: PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap.
